senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of בין) [to combine,] to build.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:1">Sabb. XII, 1</cite> <he>הַבּוֹנֶה</he> he who builds (on the Sabbath).
Ib.] 102ᵇ משום בונה (isguilty) because it is one of the labors classified under ‘building’; a. fr.—Metaph. to educate, train.
Ber. 64ᵃ (ref. to Is. LIV, 93) א״ת בָּנַיִךְ אלא בוֹנַיִּךְ read not banayikh (thy children), but bonayikh (thy builders, trainers); v. בַּנָּאִים.—

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23:10">Ex. R. s. 23</cite> (play on b’noth, <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:5">Cant. I, 5</cite>) <he>בּוֹנוֹת וכ׳</he> the authorities directing the building of Jerusalem; v. Pi.—

<cite ref="Chullin 78b:1">Ḥull. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>זה בנה אב</he>, v. <cite ref="A00017"><he>אָב</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="B00953"><he>בִּנְיָן</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 7:4">Tosef. Par. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 6:4">VI</cite>), 4 <he>בְּנָאוֹ</he> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="K00859"><he>כָּנַן</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be built up. Y. B. Bath. III, 14ᵇ, a. fr. לְהִיבָּנוֹת, לִיבָּנוֹת.

units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 43:1">Pesik. R. s. 43</cite> <he>נִתְבַּנּוּ בישראל</he> they became full Israelitish citizens.

senses.gloss: to lay out, plan a city, determine its limits. Ex. R. l. c. the Great Sanedrin held sessions ומְבַנָּים אותה (not אותם) and determined the limits of Jerusalem; v.
units: Snh. I, 5.—Part. Pu. מְבוּנֶּה cultivated; built (of human stature), well-proportioned.

<cite ref="Ketubot 112a">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 34b:10">Sot. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה מְבוּנָּה על וכ׳</he> it (Hebron, in spite of the rocky nature of its soil) was seven times better cultivated than Zoan (one measure of its land yielding as much as did seven measures of the soil of Zoan).
Ib. 42ᵇ (play on benayim, I Sam. XVII, 4) מב׳ מכל מום his build was without blemish.
